documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: RBZ Jewellers Limited reported Q1 FY27 revenue from operations at INR 121 crores, registering a 60% year-on-year growth driven by consumer demand and higher jewellery sales. EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR 18 crores with a margin of 14.9%, while Profit After Tax was INR 9 crores at a 7.5% margin. Management detailed expansion plans including launching a store in Surat in Q2 and three stores in Rajkot, Gandhinagar, and Maninagar in Q3. The company also discussed its strategic focus on expanding its retail segment, transitioning to gold metal loans for hedging, and maintaining a robust order book. RBZ Jewellers Limited reported an operational revenue of INR 1,208 million and a PAT of INR 91 million for Q1 FY27, reflecting a year-on-year revenue growth driven by customer demand and higher jewellery sales.

guidance.claim: The management stated that the B2B to B2C revenue mix is targeted to be 50-50 in a year or two and 75-25 in the long term, with 75% being retail.
guidance.quote: For revenue mix, we see that job work percentage right now in Quarter 1 stands at 54% and, the mix has to, I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two and in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates that the debt-to-equity ratio will remain below 1:1 by the end of the financial year at around 0.8 to 1.
guidance.quote: By the end of this financial year, we will be still below 1:1 ratio. I guess 0.8 will be debt and 1 equity.

guidance.claim: The company expects that the Surat store and other new stores will achieve capex break-even in a year or less.
guidance.quote: The capex when you say about the break-even point, the capex break-even will be achieved in a year or less.

guidance.claim: Management expects that by the end of the year, at least 20% of corporate sales mix will be of 18 caratage.
guidance.quote: I see by the end of this year, it will be at least 20% will be of 18 caratage.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand side looks to be good and promising for Quarter 2.
demand_outlook.quote: And the demand side looks to be good and promising for Quarter 2, as we are approaching.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue increased by approximately 60% year-on-year, supported by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue increased by ~60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that they continue to witness steady consumer demand in the occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness steady consumer demand in occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season, while also optimizing our inventory mix with a greater focus on lightweight and budget-friendly product offering to cater to evolving consumer preference.

capex_expansion.claim: The Surat store is scheduled for launch in Quarter 2, and Rajkot, Maninagar, and Gandhinagar stores will be launched in Quarter 3.
capex_expansion.quote: So, Surat will be launching in Quarter 2 and Rajkot in early Quarter 3. And same, I think Maninagar and Gandhinagar both will be launched in Quarter 3 itself. So three stores in Quarter 3 and one store in Quarter 2, that is Surat.

capex_expansion.claim: Inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR 125 crores to INR 150 crores, while in small format stores it is around INR 50 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR125 crores to INR150 crores. While in small format stores are around INR50 crores, plus and minus 10%, 15%.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex incurred for the Surat store is approximately INR 10 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Approximately INR10 crores is the capex incurred for Surat store.

capex_expansion.claim: Retail expansion remains on track with flagship showrooms in Surat and Rajkot alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar and Gandhinagar.
capex_expansion.quote: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat (by Q2) and Rajkot (by early Q3), alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar (Ahmedabad East) and Gandhinagar, aimed at strengthening geographic presence and enhancing direct customer access across high-growth Gujarat markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to expand its retail presence in Rajkot, Surat, and Ahmedabad.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also planning to expand our retail presence in Rajkot, Surat and Ahmedabad as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Both showrooms in Surat and Rajkot are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is exploring strategic locations in Eastern Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, we are actively exploring strategic location in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities such as Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet and aimed at strengthening the regional presence and driving incremental growth.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was INR 18 crores with an EBITDA margin of 14.9%, and profit after tax was INR 9 crores translating to a PAT margin of 7.5%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter is INR18 crores reflecting a healthy growth of 39% Y-o-Y, with EBITDA margins coming in a healthy 14.9%. Profit after tax for the quarter has been 28% at INR9 crores translating PAT at 7.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Management highlighted that the average gold rate remained stagnant, resulting in negligible inventory gain in the system.
margins_costs.quote: One is that the average gold rate has remained stagnant and thus there is negligible inventory gain in the system as of now.

margins_costs.claim: Lease asset amortization was reported at INR 76 lakhs and the impact of lease liabilities was stated at INR 115 lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: The amortization of lease assets is INR76 lakhs and the impact of lease liabilities is at INR115 lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: For the full year FY26, EBITDA margins improved to 14.44% with an expansion of 233 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the year increased significantly by 43% to INR92 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 14.44% and expansion of 233 basis points.

orders_capacity.claim: The total manufacturing capacity remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year.
orders_capacity.quote: The total capacity still remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year.

orders_capacity.claim: Factory capacity utilization is running at approximately 50% during normal periods and goes up to 70%-80% or higher during core season times.
orders_capacity.quote: And the production that we are doing or the consumption that we are able to do is somewhere around 900 kgs to 1000 kgs. So, we are utilizing factory at around 50% of capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The management targets maximum utilization of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, the company launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day primarily in the occasion wear segment.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day, primarily in occasion wear segment further strengthening our product portfolio
The capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has a sanctioned debt of around INR 300 crores which is sufficient for the four stores coming up this financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: Given that we have a sanctioned debt of around INR300 crores. And we are yet to utilize it, which is sufficient for the four stores that is coming in this financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: Management plans to leverage up the debt-to-equity ratio to 1.5 or 2:1 over a period of time, primarily through Gold Metal Loans.
capital_allocation.quote: Over the period of time we are wanting to gear up this to 1.5 or 2:1 debt equity ratio, wherein major leverage will be through Gold Metal Loan

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that forward-looking statements are subject to risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are subject to risks and uncertainties, which could cause actual results to differ from those anticipated.
